show.description: RA&W officer Sher Pathan aka Akash enters a deadly prison to uncover the truth behind his sister Dr. Roshini’s death. Disguised as inmate Akash, he faces a corrupt prison warden and feared criminal Shankra. With help from doctor Kavya and inmate Riya, Sher uncovers a dark conspiracy. But inside these walls, trust is dangerous and justice is buried.
